summary: This Makefile defines several helper commands for managing a Docusaurus blog project, each with a yellow-colored description message. The commands cover tasks like building the project, deploying it, starting a development server, and opening it in an editor. The `deploy` target also depends on `build`, ensuring the project is rebuilt before deployment.

explanations.1: This sets the shell that Makefile will use to execute commands to bash instead of the default sh.
explanations.3: This stores the ANSI color code for yellow (33) in a variable so it can be reused in the printf statements below.
explanations.5: .PHONY tells Make that 'bash' is not a real file to create, just a command label — this prevents Make from getting confused if a file named 'bash' exists.
explanations.7: The @ symbol suppresses echoing the command itself to the output. The printf uses ANSI escape codes (\e[1;...m) to print the help text in bold yellow, then resets the color with \e[0m.
explanations.18: The colon after 'deploy' means this target depends on 'build' — Make will run the build target first before running deploy's commands.
